learning_outcomes.text: Gain knowledge and skills regarding the basic principles, methods and technical means of providing electrical safety when working with electrical devices, appliances and installations.
Develop the ability to make decisions using examples and cases from the industry.

syllabus_topics: Influences alternative and direct current of people

Climate and mechanical resistance to cold, dry heat, temperature changes, sudden temperature changes, corrosion atmosphere, vibrations, noise, changes of the air pressure, sun radiation, contaminating fluids and their combinations
Fire safety and explosion-proof safety in the electric equipment’s
Influence noise and vibrations of electrical equipment
Protection against over voltages of atmospheric origin or due to switching
assessment_rules: Early passing of the exam is not allowed. At the exam, students answer one question to estimate their degree of knowledge.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Electrical Power Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS FEEA (datos antiguos; ver notas)
